profile.headline: Software Engineer - Looking to build beautiful and meaningful things!
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineer, currently making scalable web applications using Ruby on Rails and Javascript. I love meeting new people, so send me a connection request!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Building developer tooling and infrastructure to accelerate ML engineering workflows for Siri and on-device ML applications
• Developing full-stack solutions across the ML development lifecycle, enabling faster iteration from experimentation to production deployment
• Collaborating with ML engineers to identify bottlenecks and build productivity-multiplying tools using modern development practices
• Working as a hyper-generalist across multiple technical domains, rapidly context-switching between varied projects and codebases

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Optimized data-heavy analytics dashboards through performance improvements including async fetching, reducing load times and improving user experience
• Contributed to platform security through vulnerability triage, validation, and rapid implementation of fixes during security rotation assignments

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed 3 AI focused internal demos, showcasing the potential of AI for improving user experience, both on existing apps and future applications in the metaverse.
• Incorporated machine learning into Facebook Assistant, a key feature in Ray-bans stories.
• Migrated cutting edge AI models from internal AI researchers onto our internal platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created a web API to onboard clients moving over $3 million worth of assets to be managed by investment services.
• Architected internal tools to eliminate manual processes, leading to a 20% reduction in customer call times.
• Migrated 5,000+ lines of code from coffeescript to ES6, with the intention of upgrading from React 14 to React 16.
• Refactored 50,000+ lines of code with Rubocop to ensure code readability in concordance with Ruby best practices.
• Took sole initiative to upgrade internal tools to automate create onboarding procedures, eliminating expensive engineering manual data tasks.
• Created tests using axe DevTools to test and maintain accessibility of our web application for disabled individuals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a product information portal using HTML, CSS, Javascript and Ruby on Rails, and made it language agnostic to cater to non-English speakers.
• Built product using Test Driven Development and Continuous Deployment practices in order to shorten release cycles and reduce testing overhead at each deployment.

positions.title: Web Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built web frontend features using React and Redux alongside a team of software engineers and architects.
• Architected and implemented a passwordless login system to enable users to login using their mobile phones. This new login feature was successfully adapted by 100,000+ users in under 2 months.
• Led the development of a UI redesign using HTML, CSS and Javascript. Collaborated with designers and product managers to perform A/B tests over multiple UI designs, and determined an optimal design.
• Migrated the frontend codebase from archaic Backbone implementation to React and Redux.
• Designed and implemented a process to automatically construct sitemaps containing 250,000+ URLS for search engine web crawlers. This improved site visibility and increased traffic to our product. 
• Developed internal tools with Ruby on Rails and JavaScript to enable PMs and sales team to develop their own Vertica based database queries, saving company over $107,400 annually in engineering time.
• Collaborated with product managers, QA engineers, and backend developers to create and run cross-platform tests for RESTful APIs and new features utilizing RSpec and Jest.

positions.title: Senior Counselor
positions.description: • Managed a team of 8 counselors to coordinate effort in helping underprivileged students transition away from unhealthy environments and start an independent lifestyle.

positions.title: Support Counselor
positions.description:
• Acted as a point of contact between clients, social workers, management, and youth advocates.
• Created an open environment for emotionally damaged foster children to feel safe and comfortable expressing themselves.

positions.title: Event/Equipment Manager
positions.description:
• Managed all aspects of various student and administration events, including UC Davis Commencements, Agricultural Research Conventions, the UC Davis Engineering Development Forum, and the Aggie Fair.
• Provided excellent customer support in order to ensure top quality implementation of events.
• Planned and staffed multicultural, professional and recreational events at the UC Davis Chancellor’s House, the UC Davis Pavilion, UC Merced, UC Davis Medical Center, and the UC Davis Conference Center.
• Utilized VectorWorks to create floor plans for clients and event setups.

projects.title: Decidr
projects.description: An application built with Flask that uses Yelp's API to return the result of a query from a user. Built for DBC's Civic Hackathon in January 2016.

projects.title: The Bucket List
projects.description: The Bucket List is an application built in Meteor with the React.js library. It allows users to create, organize, and maintain their own bucket list while including a searchable map provided through the Google Maps API should they want to search up items related to their bucket list item. None of our team members had any experience with Meteor or React prior to this project; we wanted to push ourselves and see how much new technology we could learn in a week.
